𝗡𝗭 𝟴𝟯/𝟰 𝗜𝗡 𝟮𝟭.𝟯! 🔥🇮🇳

NZ are 83/4 chasing 210 in the 5th ODI decider; 127 more needed.
Siraj and Arshdeep struck early. India lead 2-1.

Who wins from here? 👇

#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

facebook.caption:
𝗡𝗭 𝟴𝟯/𝟰 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡 𝗨𝗟𝗝𝗛𝗔! 🔥🇮🇳

👉 5th ODI decider: NZ ko jeetne ke liye 210 chahiye, 21.3 over mein score 83/4
👉 Siraj aur Arshdeep ne shuruaat mein hi wickets nikaale
👉 NZ ko ab bhi 127 run aur chahiye, India series mein 2-1 se aage

Kaun jeetega ye decider? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
